# Misconfigured admonitions

Every Admonition needs a type, and it is one of note, info, warning and
danger. A misconfigured one shows its error in its place.

<Admonition id="no_type" title="No type" description="It has no type." />

<Admonition id="unknown_type" type="tip" description="There is no tip type." />

A hide for good needs its `storageKey`, and its confirmation button.

<Admonition id="no_storage_key" type="info" description="Hidden under what?" confirmationText="Got it" allowPermanentHide={true} />

<Admonition id="no_hide" type="info" description="A storageKey alone hides nothing." storageKey="welcome" />

<Admonition id="fine" type="note" description="The runbook's other blocks still work." />
